institution.en: Union — Nikola Tesla University · Faculty of Construction Management, Belgrade
institution.sr: Univerzitet „Union — Nikola Tesla” · Fakultet za graditeljski menadžment, Beograd

notice.en: Start with one record. Predict, connect the views, execute a rule, then try a new case.
notice.sr: Počni od jednog zapisa. Predvidi, poveži prikaze, izvedi pravilo, pa probaj novi slučaj.

prompt.en: A sum starts at 0. We add 12, then 18, then 15. What is the state immediately after the second addition?
prompt.sr: Zbir kreće od 0. Dodajemo 12, zatim 18, pa 15. Koje je stanje odmah posle drugog sabiranja?

explanation.en: The second step starts at 12 and adds 18. The state becomes 30. The final value 45 belongs to the next step.
explanation.sr: Drugi korak kreće od 12 i dodaje 18. Stanje postaje 30. Završnih 45 pripada sledećem koraku.

transfer.en: Now start at 5. What changes after each step? Explain before running.
transfer.sr: Sada kreni od 5. Šta se menja posle svakog koraka? Objasni pre pokretanja.

title.en: Order is part of the design.

prompt.en: Start at (1,0). Translate +4 along x, then rotate 90° counterclockwise around the origin. Where is the point?
prompt.sr: Kreni iz (1,0). Pomeri +4 po x, pa rotiraj 90° suprotno kazaljci sata oko početka. Gde je tačka?

explanation.en: (1,0) → (5,0) → (0,5). Reversing the operations gives (4,1). This uses mathematical x/y coordinates.
explanation.sr: (1,0) → (5,0) → (0,5). Obrnut redosled daje (4,1). Koristimo matematičke x/y koordinate.

transfer.en: Rotate about a different origin. Which assumption changed?
transfer.sr: Rotiraj oko drugog početka. Koja pretpostavka se promenila?

prompt.en: A solid wall is 4000 × 3000 × 200 mm. Its volume is…
prompt.sr: Pun zid ima mere 4000 × 3000 × 200 mm. Njegova zapremina je…

choices.en: 2.4 m³

explanation.en: Divide cubic millimetres by 1000³ = 1,000,000,000. Openings, layers and overlaps are not included in this rectangular model.
explanation.sr: Kubne milimetre delimo sa 1000³ = 1.000.000.000. Otvori, slojevi i preklopi nisu deo ovog pravougaonog modela.

transfer.en: Double only the thickness. Predict the volume, then check.
transfer.sr: Udvostruči samo debljinu. Predvidi zapreminu pa proveri.

prompt.en: A takes 2 time units. Then B takes 3 and C takes 1. B and C require the same single crane. With no overlap, the earliest finish is…
prompt.sr: A traje 2 jedinice vremena. Posle njega B traje 3, a C traje 1. B i C koriste istu jednu dizalicu. Bez preklapanja, najraniji kraj je…

explanation.en: A ends at 2. The crane then performs 3 + 1 units of work: finish 6. Ignoring crane capacity incorrectly allows both jobs to overlap and predicts 5.
explanation.sr: A završava u 2. Dizalica zatim radi 3 + 1: kraj je 6. Zanemarivanje kapaciteta dozvoljava preklapanje i predviđa 5.

transfer.en: Add a second crane. Is that the only possible bottleneck on a real site?
transfer.sr: Dodaj drugu dizalicu. Da li je ona jedino moguće usko grlo na stvarnom gradilištu?

title.en: Half the height is not half the work.

prompt.en: Our invented four-layer pyramid has 49, 25, 9 and 1 cells from bottom to top. After the bottom layer, what fraction of all cells is placed?
prompt.sr: Naša izmišljena piramida sa četiri sloja ima 49, 25, 9 i 1 ćeliju odozdo naviše. Posle donjeg sloja, koliki deo svih ćelija je ugrađen?

choices.en: About 58%

explanation.en: There are 84 cells in total. 49/84 ≈ 58.33%, but only one of four layers is complete. Cell count is not labour time. This is a teaching model, not a reconstruction of Giza.
explanation.sr: Ukupno ima 84 ćelije. 49/84 ≈ 58,33%, ali završen je tek jedan od četiri sloja. Broj ćelija nije vreme rada. Ovo je nastavni model, ne rekonstrukcija Gize.

transfer.en: Would every cell cost the same effort to lift? What data would we need?
transfer.sr: Da li svaka ćelija zahteva isti napor za podizanje? Koji podaci nam nedostaju?

title.en: A picture is not a property.

prompt.en: A rectangular BIM object looks like a wall. Can its picture alone prove its material, fire rating or verified as-built state?
prompt.sr: Pravougaoni BIM objekat izgleda kao zid. Može li samo slika dokazati materijal, požarnu otpornost ili potvrđeno izvedeno stanje?

choices.en: Yes, if the render is detailed
No; we need data and evidence
choices.sr: Ne; potrebni su podaci i dokazi

choices.en: Yes, if AI recognises it

explanation.en: Geometry, semantic class, declared property and evidence are different layers. A convincing AI answer does not supply missing measurements or provenance.
explanation.sr: Geometrija, semantički tip, deklarisano svojstvo i dokaz su različiti slojevi. Uverljiv AI odgovor ne daje nedostajuće merenje ili poreklo.

transfer.en: Write the three missing questions you would ask before using the value.
transfer.sr: Napiši tri nedostajuća pitanja koja bi postavio pre upotrebe vrednosti.

prompt.en: A note contains only “600”. Which addition makes it a usable width record for our panel exercise?
prompt.sr: Na papiru piše samo „600”. Koja dopuna ga čini upotrebljivim zapisom širine za naš zadatak sa panelima?

choices.en: A larger font and a blue rectangle
P1 · width · 600 mm · given in task v1
choices.sr: P1 · širina · 600 mm · zadato u zadatku v1

explanation.en: The ID, property, unit and origin tell us how to interpret the value. They do not establish height, material or a real measurement.
explanation.sr: ID, svojstvo, jedinica i poreklo govore kako tumačimo vrednost. Ne utvrđuju visinu, materijal ili stvarno merenje.

transfer.en: Receive “1.2” as a height. Ask what is missing before combining it with the width.
transfer.sr: Dobijaš „1,2” kao visinu. Pitaj šta nedostaje pre povezivanja sa širinom.

prompt.en: Two 2×3 grids use six 600×600 mm panels: two glass and four solid, without gaps. Do those quantities determine where the glass panels are?
prompt.sr: Dve mreže 2×3 koriste šest panela 600×600 mm: dva staklena i četiri puna, bez razmaka. Da li te količine određuju položaje staklenih panela?

choices.en: Yes; equal quantities mean the same arrangement
choices.sr: Da; iste količine znače isti raspored

choices.en: Yes, if the area is calculated exactly
choices.sr: Da, ako je površina tačno izračunata

choices.en: No; positions or an arrangement rule are missing
choices.sr: Ne; nedostaju položaji ili pravilo rasporeda

explanation.en: Both can contain 0.72 m² of glass and 1.44 m² of solid panels while placing the glass differently. A quantity total preserves amount, not layout.
explanation.sr: Obe mogu imati 0,72 m² staklenih i 1,44 m² punih panela, a drugačije položaje stakla. Zbir čuva količinu, ne raspored.

transfer.en: Draw two such facades: let the glass panels share an edge in only one. What extra record would distinguish them?
transfer.sr: Nacrtaj dve takve fasade: neka stakleni paneli dele ivicu samo u jednoj. Koji dodatni zapis ih razlikuje?

prompt.en: Three panels are each 600 mm wide. Internal gaps are 20 mm; there are no outer gaps. What is the total width?
prompt.sr: Tri panela su široka po 600 mm. Unutrašnji razmaci su 20 mm; spoljnih nema. Kolika je ukupna širina?

explanation.en: 3×600 + (3−1)×20 = 1840 mm. For n≥1, a straight row without outer gaps has n−1 internal gaps. Panel material area excludes these empty gaps.
explanation.sr: 3×600 + (3−1)×20 = 1840 mm. Za n≥1, prav red bez spoljnih razmaka ima n−1 unutrašnjih razmaka. Površina materijala panela izostavlja te praznine.

transfer.en: Check one panel, then four. Explain why the one-panel case exposes a mistaken extra gap.
transfer.sr: Proveri jedan panel, pa četiri. Objasni zašto slučaj jednog panela otkriva pogrešan dodatni razmak.

title.en: A neighbour is not the next row.

prompt.en: The spatial grid is A B C / D E F. Neighbours share an edge, not only a corner. The table lists F, A, D, C, B, E. Which panels neighbour B?
prompt.sr: Prostorna mreža je A B C / D E F. Susedi dele ivicu, a ne samo ugao. Tabela navodi F, A, D, C, B, E. Koji paneli su susedi B?

choices.en: A, C and E
C and E, because they surround B in the table
choices.sr: C i E, jer okružuju B u tabeli

choices.en: A, C, D, E and F
choices.sr: A, C, D, E i F

explanation.en: Use spatial coordinates: one coordinate is equal and the other differs by one. A, C and E share an edge with B. Reordering table rows changes no position.
explanation.sr: Koristi prostorne koordinate: jedna je jednaka, a druga se razlikuje za jedan. A, C i E dele ivicu sa B. Promena redosleda tabele ne menja položaje.

transfer.en: Find E’s neighbours, then reverse the table order. Which result must stay unchanged?
transfer.sr: Pronađi susede E, pa obrni redosled tabele. Koji rezultat mora ostati isti?

title.en: One panel belongs to two groups.

prompt.en: Group A contains P1/P2/P3; group B contains P3/P4/P5. P3 is the same physical panel. Each is 0.60×1.20 m. Counting each panel once, what is the total material area?
prompt.sr: Grupa A sadrži P1/P2/P3; grupa B P3/P4/P5. P3 je isti fizički panel. Svaki ima 0,60×1,20 m. Ako svaki brojimo jednom, kolika je ukupna površina materijala?

explanation.en: There are five distinct IDs, each with area 0.72 m². Adding two correct group subtotals counts P3 twice. We are counting panels, not the coating of both faces.
explanation.sr: Ima pet različitih ID-jeva, svaki sa 0,72 m². Sabiranje dva tačna podzbira broji P3 dvaput. Brojimo panele, ne obloge obe strane.

transfer.en: Only P3 becomes 1.50 m high. Predict both group subtotals and the unique total before calculating.
transfer.sr: Samo P3 postaje visok 1,50 m. Predvidi oba podzbira i jedinstveni zbir pre računanja.

prompt.en: A program correctly reports 2.16 m² for three 600×1200 mm panels. Does this prove the model is sufficient to price the installed assembly?
prompt.sr: Program tačno javlja 2,16 m² za tri panela 600×1200 mm. Da li to dokazuje da je model dovoljan za cenu ugrađenog sklopa?

choices.en: Yes; a correct calculation proves the whole model
choices.sr: Da; tačan račun potvrđuje ceo model

choices.en: No; pricing also needs relevant prices, work and other stated assumptions
choices.sr: Ne; za cenu su potrebne odgovarajuće cene, rad i druge navedene pretpostavke

choices.en: Yes, after saving and reopening the file
choices.sr: Da, posle čuvanja i ponovnog otvaranja fajla

explanation.en: Executing the stated area rule correctly is one check. Whether that rule and its inputs answer a pricing question is another. Saving a file does not supply missing evidence.
explanation.sr: Tačno izvođenje zadatog pravila površine je jedna provera. Da li pravilo i ulazi odgovaraju na pitanje cene, druga je provera. Čuvanje fajla ne daje nedostajuće dokaze.

transfer.en: Choose one new question about the assembly. Name one necessary input and one result the current model cannot establish.
transfer.sr: Izaberi novo pitanje o sklopu. Navedi jedan potreban ulaz i jedan rezultat koji sadašnji model ne može da utvrdi.

description.en: Before any file, a real building already carries a story: material, origin, builders. A digital passport decides what of that story survives.
description.sr: Pre svakog fajla, stvarna zgrada već nosi priču: materijal, poreklo, graditelje. Digitalni pasoš odlučuje šta od te priče opstaje.

description.en: Files are agreements about how to read a sequence.
description.sr: Fajl je dogovor o čitanju niza.

description.en: Name inputs, steps, outputs and stopping conditions.
description.sr: Imenuj ulaz, korake, izlaz i uslov zaustavljanja.

description.en: Identity, units, relationships and BIM semantics.
description.sr: Identitet, jedinice, veze i BIM značenje.

description.en: Assumptions, simulation and checking an AI proposal.
description.sr: Pretpostavke, simulacija i provera AI predloga.

description.en: What is allowed now, and what changes next?
description.sr: Šta je sada dozvoljeno i šta se sledeće menja?

description.en: Paths, dependencies, waiting and shared resources.
description.sr: Putevi, zavisnosti, čekanje i zajednički resursi.

description.en: A boundary, a subdivision, a packing problem.
Numerical precision and the limits of a structural model.
description.sr: Numerička preciznost i granice modela konstrukcije.

description.en: Data size, complexity, approximation and uncertainty.
description.sr: Veličina podataka, složenost, aproksimacija i neizvesnost.

question.en: 600 what, for which object, and from where?
question.sr: 600 čega, za koji predmet i iz kog izvora?

action.en: Turn one number into an identified value with a unit and origin.
action.sr: Poveži broj sa predmetom, jedinicom i poreklom.

question.en: Can the same quantities describe two different facades?
question.sr: Mogu li iste količine opisati dve različite fasade?

action.en: Match a panel in the drawing and table; name what a quantity total omits.
action.sr: Poveži panel u crtežu i tabeli; imenuj šta zbir količina izostavlja.

question.en: Does changing table order change spatial neighbours?
question.sr: Da li promena redosleda tabele menja prostorne susede?

action.en: Use IDs and coordinates to find shared edges, then reorder the records.
action.sr: Pronađi zajedničke ivice pomoću ID-jeva i koordinata, pa promeni redosled zapisa.

question.en: Why do three panels have only two internal gaps?
question.sr: Zašto tri panela imaju samo dva unutrašnja razmaka?

action.en: Predict the width, write a rule and check one panel before changing the count.
action.sr: Predvidi širinu, zapiši pravilo i proveri jedan panel pre promene broja.

concept.en: A rule, its domain and an edge case
concept.sr: Pravilo, njegov domen i granični slučaj

question.en: Which value changes at this step, and which stays the same?
question.sr: Koja vrednost se menja u ovom koraku, a koja ostaje ista?

action.en: Connect an instruction to its inputs, state and visible consequence.
action.sr: Poveži naredbu sa njenim ulazima, stanjem i vidljivom posledicom.

question.en: What changes when two groups refer to the same panel?
question.sr: Šta se menja kada dve grupe upućuju na isti panel?

action.en: Trace shared IDs, check the whole, save a local version and try another case.
action.sr: Prati zajedničke ID-jeve, proveri celinu, sačuvaj lokalnu verziju i probaj drugi slučaj.
